title: Blackcomb opens, Brass Camel and Anything Goes: your Sea to Sky weekend
description: Blackcomb opens Friday, weather permitting. Ski season is basically here. Plus Anything Goes in Whistler, two nights of Heavy Fest, Brass Camel in Brackendale and a new show at the Audain. 17 picks for Whistler, Squamish and Britannia Beach.
intro: Blackcomb opens Friday, weather permitting. Ski season is basically here. Plus Anything Goes in Whistler, two nights of Heavy Fest, Brass Camel in Brackendale and a new show at the Audain. 17 picks for Whistler, Squamish and Britannia Beach.

entries.name: Opening Day: Blackcomb is open
entries.blurb: Here we go. Blackcomb kicks off the season Friday, with base lifts turning from 9 AM. Whistler Mountain, PEAK 2 PEAK and Creekside follow on Wednesday, Nov 25. All of it is conditions permitting, so check the hours page before you load the car.

entries.name: Eleven Painters Start A War opens
entries.venue: Audain Art Museum, 4350 Blackcomb Way, Whistler
entries.blurb: Opening day for the Audain’s big new show on the eleven painters who shook up Canadian abstract art. It runs to May 3, 2027, so no rush, but it’s a great rainy day plan.

entries.name: Anything Goes: The Musical
entries.venue: Maury Young Arts Centre, 4335 Blackcomb Way, Whistler
entries.blurb: The Pemberton Arts Council theatre crew brings Cole Porter’s classic down the valley to Whistler: tap numbers, mistaken identities and big songs. Night one of two.

entries.name: Heavy Fest, night one
entries.blurb: The first ever Heavy Fest. Friday’s lineup: Heavy Trip, Trenchraid, Druin, Hushed and Morsh. Loud, sludgy and stoner-y. Bring earplugs.

entries.name: Sip & Savour dine-around
entries.blurb: Tourism Squamish’s dine-around runs to Nov 26. Think Autostrada, Howe Sound Brew Pub, House of Lager, Tacofino, Raincity Distillery and more, each with a special menu or pour.

entries.name: Ore & Orcas: Howe Sound, a recovering ecosystem
entries.blurb: A new temporary exhibit on how Howe Sound’s marine life is bouncing back. Good one for kids, and an easy stop on a Sea to Sky drive.

entries.name: Handmade Histories: Britannia’s Memories at our Fingertips
entries.blurb: Scrapbooks and photo albums made by the people who lived in Britannia, showing what town life was really like. Just opened this week.

entries.name: Solstice: Through Storm & Stillness
entries.venue: Audain Art Museum, 4350 Blackcomb Way, Whistler
entries.blurb: Pair it with the new Eleven Painters show. Solstice pulls from the Audain’s permanent collection on a season of storms and renewal, and runs to Apr 12, 2027.

entries.name: Anything Goes: The Musical
entries.venue: Maury Young Arts Centre, 4335 Blackcomb Way, Whistler
entries.blurb: Last chance to catch the Cole Porter musical in Whistler.

entries.name: SORCA Dig Day #12 with DHaRCO and Tacofino
entries.venue: Singletrack Mind, Valleycliffe. Meet at the washrooms near Squamish Canyon
entries.blurb: Give back to the trails you ride. Tools are provided, and minors need to come with an adult.

entries.name: Giant Wreath Workshop
entries.venue: Pink Tuna Cafe, 38209 Westway Ave, Squamish
entries.blurb: Whistler Flower School’s Barbora walks you through building a big holiday wreath to take home.

entries.name: Coast Mountain Folk Trad Session
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Monthly traditional music session with Jocelyn Pettit and Coast Mountain Folk. Bring an instrument or just come listen. There’s an optional prep workshop from 11 AM if you email to sign up.

entries.name: Heavy Fest, night two
entries.blurb: Saturday’s lineup: Anciients, Burnt Lung, The Subteraliens, Bong Witch and Shiny Red Button.

entries.name: Brass Camel with Chopping Spree
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: A Saturday night show at the gallery. Chopping Spree opens, with Brass Camel up later. All ages.
warnings: Time unconfirmed: listing says 9 PM, Brass Camel around 10 PM

entries.name: Sarah Hagen, piano
entries.venue: Maury Young Arts Centre, 4335 Blackcomb Way, Whistler
entries.blurb: The Whistler Chamber Music Society presents pianist Sarah Hagen. An easy early evening concert to cap the weekend. Doors 4:30 PM.

entries.name: Create Public Art Pitch Night
entries.blurb: Local makers pitch big public art ideas for festivals, parks and public spaces around the Sea to Sky. Come watch, cheer and vote. Cash bar and snacks.
warnings: Time unconfirmed: listing says 6 to 9 PM, ticket data says 5 to 8 PM

entries.name: Blind Book Swap
entries.venue: Smoke Bluff Coffee House, 1907 Maple Dr, Squamish
entries.blurb: Wrap up a favourite book, swap it for a mystery one. Bookmark station, literary games and a raffle while you wait. Aimed at adults.
warnings: Time unconfirmed: Eventbrite headline says 7 to 8:30 PM

notes: Confirm before you go. Details were checked on Nov 18, 2026 from the source pages linked above. Check the event pages directly before heading out, especially listings marked with time warnings.
Heads up: the Sea to Sky Gondola is closed Nov 16 to 26 for annual maintenance and reopens Friday, Nov 27 (seatoskygondola.com https://www.seatoskygondola.com/hours-and-prices/).
